subject: Renewal + expansion roadmap demo — evening bridge & fallback
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@healthly.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@healthly.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + expansion roadmap demo — evening bridge & fallback

Hi Amy / Raj —

Hope you’re both well. As we near your renewal window, we’d like to schedule a consolidated roadmap + expansion QBR focused on:

- Proposed product milestones for H2 (batching + cost-saving configs)
- Dedicated capacity recommendations for your ingestion spikes
- Ops and fallback plan for cross-region demos (so execs stay covered)

A few asks to keep this tight:
1) Do you have an evening slot the week of Jun 7 that works for an hour (so your East Coast execs can join)? Preferably a 7:00–8:15 PM PDT window so we can run a demo + Q&A.
2) Are any participants unable to be recorded? We typically record for internal notes and to feed into our Optimize follow-up.
3) Can you share the list of attendees (titles)? We’ll map technical vs. exec segments.

Attached is a draft agenda (QBR_Agenda_v2.pdf). If you’re short on time, we can compress the demo and send a short recording.

If evening is untenable, propose two daytime alternatives and we’ll provide a backup host plan.

Thanks — aiming to lock timing by Friday so we can reserve Dedicated capacity for your demo.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_Agenda_v2.pdf

Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 09:21:00 -04:00

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the heads-up and agenda. Quick notes from our side:

- Evening works better for our execs this week. Jun 9 at 7:00 PM PDT (10:00 PM ET) is the best single option; Jun 8 at 7:30 PM PDT is a backup.
- Recording: our CISO prefers no external recordings of technical deep-dives. Exec summary recording is fine. Can you split the session so the technical deep-dive is unrecorded?
- Attendees: myself (Head of Data), Raj (CTO), Lina Torres (Security, may only join for 20m), and two Product directors (TBD).

If you can provide a 10-minute tech-only pre-brief for Lina, that would help — she avoids long public recordings.

Amy
Amy Chen
Head of Data
Healthly

- Host plan: Rishi (AE) — execs/contract items, Marissa (SE) — live demo, Tessa (CSM) — post-demo success plan and onboarding talkback.
- Recording split: We can run the session in two parts. Part A (25m) = exec + roadmap (recorded). Part B (35m) = technical deep-dive (no recording). We’ll stop recording before the technical portion and restart for the short exec wrap only if needed.
- Backup hosts: If Marissa is pulled into another call, Tessa will cover demo with predefined demo script v3.2 (runbook_summary.txt).
- Pre-brief for Lina: Marissa can do a 10-minute technical pre-brief on Jun 8 at 12:00 PM PT (we can make that virtual or a 15-min call).

I’ll prepare the attendee slide that separates "recorded" vs "not recorded" sections and share a calendar invite with time zones and a stub meeting description. Also adding the DocuSign SOW link to finalize expansion scope post-demo.

Marissa Cole

- Agenda split: 25m exec/roadmap (recorded), 35m technical deep-dive (no recording). We’ll annotate the invite clearly.

If anyone needs the meeting moved by EOD Friday, flag it now — otherwise we’ll treat this as locked. Thanks all for the quick turnaround. Looking forward to walking through the ops-based recommendations that will help reduce your token spend during spikes.

Best,
